transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm... I'm a teacher. I just... I've been having some trouble at work lately. It's just that I keep getting these emails from the staff, and... the morning announcements. They just feel like they're directed at me. Like there's some kind of message in them. My colleagues keep telling me they're just standard emails sent to everyone, but... I don't know. It just doesn't feel right.
How long have you been noticing that these emails and announcements seem to be directed at you?

I suppose... it's been about four months. That's when I started worrying about the messages. And... well, sometimes there's a voice, too. That I catch myself answering. But yes, it's all been going on for about four months.
Over these same four months, have you noticed any changes in your mood, like feeling unusually sad, hopeless, or on the other hand, unusually elated, energetic, or needing much less sleep than usual?
No, not really. I... I don't think my mood has changed much. I just try to get through the day. I haven't felt unusually sad or energetic or anything like that. Just... normal, I suppose.
Do you have any medical conditions, take any medications, or use alcohol or recreational drugs that might be relevant here?
No. I... I don't have any medical problems. I don't take anything. And I don't drink or use drugs.
Can you tell me more about this voice you mentioned—does it sound like it's coming from outside your head, as if someone is actually speaking to you, or does it feel more like your own thoughts?

It... it sounds like it's outside. Like someone is actually standing there. 

Usually, it happens when it's quiet... at home, or after the students leave my classroom for the day. It's a woman. She just... says my name, or makes a short comment about what I'm doing. It sounds so clear that I... well, I end up answering her out loud before I realize no one is there.
Have these experiences affected your ability to teach, concentrate, or perform your daily responsibilities at work?

I’m still teaching. But... I suppose I've needed some help lately. A few of my coworkers have had to cover parts of my project lessons... and help me get through our planning meetings. 

Outside of work, I just... I haven't been doing much. I stopped going to my book club and the theater. I'm just not really reliable for those neighborhood events right now.

Before these voices and the feeling that messages were about you started four months ago, did you notice any earlier changes—like withdrawing from people, feeling less motivated, or having odd beliefs—going back further than four months?

I suppose... yes, things started changing before the voices. It's been... well, since my youngest left for college. That was about a year and two months ago. I just... I haven't been the same since then. With my work, and... being around people. It's just been different.
